content.content: # RichMarkdown Feature Showcase This document demonstrates all the advanced features of the RichMarkdown editor, including **inline card references**, **block card embeds**, **inline field values**, and the new **ToastMark syntax**. --- ## Team Members (Inline Card References) Our development team consists of talented individuals: - Lead Developer: :card[Jamie Chen]{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/jamie-chen} - Frontend Specialist: :card[Sarah Williams]{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/sarah-williams} - QA Engineer: :card[Marcus Johnson]{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/marcus-johnson} Click any name above to view their full profile card! --- ## Current Sprint Tasks (Block Card Embeds) Here are the tasks we're tracking this sprint: ::card{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Task/deploy-staging format=fitted width=320 height=200} ::card{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Task/run-tests format=fitted width=320 height=200} --- ## Project Metrics (Inline Field Values) Key performance indicators for this quarter: | Metric | Value | Status | | --- | --- | --- | | Sprint Velocity | :field[28 pts]{type=number data='28'} | On Track | | Test Coverage | :field[94%]{type=percentage data='0.94'} | Excellent | | Bug Count | :field[3 open]{type=string data='3 open'} | Low | | Release Date | :field[Feb 15, 2026]{type=date data='2026-02-15'} | Scheduled | --- ## ToastMark Extended Syntax The following examples demonstrate the new `$` prefix syntax for custom blocks: ### Custom Block Syntax $$note title: Important This is a custom note block that will render with special styling. Perfect for callouts and important information. $$ $$warning type: caution Be careful when deploying to production without running the full test suite first! $$ ### Custom Inline Syntax You can also use inline custom syntax: $highlight[highlighted text] and $badge[v2.0]{color=green} for inline elements. --- ## Code Examples ### TypeScript Card Definition ``` import { CardDef, field, contains, StringField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/card-api'; export class BlogPost extends CardDef { @field title = contains(StringField); @field content = contains(RichMarkdownField); @field author = linksTo(() => Person); } ``` ### Glimmer Template ``` ``` --- ## Rich Formatting Examples ### Blockquotes > "The best way to predict the future is to invent it." — Alan Kay ### Nested Lists 1. **Phase 1: Foundation** - Set up development environment - Create base card definitions - Implement authentication 1. **Phase 2: Features** - Rich text editing - Card embedding - Real-time sync 1. **Phase 3: Polish** - Performance optimization - Accessibility improvements - Documentation ### Task Checklist - [ ] Design the schema - [ ] Implement ProseMirror integration - [x] Add dual-mode editing - [ ] Enable ToastMark parsing - [x] Add track changes support --- ## Linked Cards Section The cards below are linked via the `linkedCards` relationship: ::card{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/jamie-chen format=fitted width=300 height=200} ::card{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/sarah-williams format=fitted width=300 height=200} --- ## Summary This document showcases: | Feature | Syntax | Example | | --- | --- | --- | | Inline Card | `:card[Label]{id=...}` | Team member links | | Block Card | `::card{id=... format=fitted}` | Task embeds | | Inline Field | `:field[Value]{type=... data='...'}` | Metric values | | ToastMark Block | `$$type ... $$` | Notes, warnings | | ToastMark Inline | `$type[content]{attrs}` | Highlights, badges | **Authored by:** :card[Jamie Chen]{id=https://realms-staging.stack.cards/ctse/integral-wolverine/Person/jamie-chen} **Last Updated:** :field[February 7, 2026]{type=date data='2026-02-07'}
